fusions.name: Both Prongs
fusions.desc: Two thrusts of the tines, each dealing 4 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Parted Rows
fusions.desc: Rakes rows out from your feet, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Diversion Ditch
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Between the Stones
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
